caption: The drawing depicts a centrally positioned, urn-shaped object with a lid and a knob on top, set upon a shallow, circular tray. The urn and tray are rendered in grayscale pencil or ink, with detailed shading to suggest a metallic or reflective surface. The urn has a wide, rounded body that narrows towards the base, which then flares out slightly to meet the tray. The lid is dome-shaped with a small cylindrical handle protruding from the center. The tray is broad, flat, and round, supporting the urn. The objects are enclosed within a large rectangular border situated in the center of the page. There are two smaller boxes intersecting the large rectangle: one in the upper left corner showing a miniature, outlined version of the urn and tray with handwritten dimension notes, and one in the lower right, containing a circular, cross-sectional or top-down schematic of the urn and tray. The background is a plain, tan or off-white color with some age-related discoloration at the edges.
